items.title: Moving to practice-based psychotherapy research in low- and middle-income contexts
items.author: Chris Evans
items.content: Practice-based research prioritizes contextualized evidence over standard experimental methods of evidence production. In this Perspective, Paz & Evans describe why a practice-based evidence paradigm should be implemented in psychotherapy research, particularly in low- and middle-income contexts.

items.title: Cultural impacts on memory and their applications in legal, clinical and political settings
items.author: Annelies Vredeveldt
items.content: Memory construction is inextricable from culture and has critical consequences for one’s identity, actions and mental health. In this Review, Wang et al. synthesize the intersections between culture and memory, focusing on memory for specific events and highlighting legal, clinical and political settings.
